scenario_name: Guest mentions tier at competitor property
expected_behavior: Translates the Caesars Diamond status into Momentum-equivalent context. Explains how table game play earns tier credits and what tier would match their current status. Makes signing up feel like a strategic move for a serious player, not a marketing exercise
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest mentions tier status at a competitor, the agent recognizes the status signal and positions Mohegan Sun's Momentum tiers as comparable or better for their play level. Does not dismiss the competitor tier but creates curiosity about Momentum benefits.

turns.user_message: I'm Diamond at Caesars. What do you have here that's comparable?
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, the Momentum program at Mohegan Sun is structured into five tiers: Core, Ignite (2,500 Tier Credits), Leap (10,000 Tier Credits), Ascend (25,000 Tier Credits), and Soar (invitation only). The Ascend tier provides premium benefits such as complimentary valet, room upgrades, and access to a dedicated host. 

To join, you can visit any Momentum Desk on the casino floor with your identification, where a representative can also discuss your play history and potential tier placement. New members may be eligible for a $10 introductory free play bonus upon signing up for the program. Our high-limit gaming areas also offer premium drink service and dedicated hosts for those playing at that level. Are you primarily interested in slot play or table games during your visit?

turns.user_message: How fast can I move up? I play mostly table games
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, tier advancement for table players is determined by your average bet and duration of play. Presenting your Momentum card at any of our 370 table games ensures your Tier Credits are tracked accurately. High-limit areas with dedicated hosts are the most direct path to higher tiers like Ascend, which also unlock priority Arena access and VIP Wolf Den seating. 

I can look into arranging a complimentary appetizer for you at Tuscany for your first night—do you prefer Blackjack or Baccarat?

turns.user_message: Alright, I'll sign up at the Momentum Desk
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, the Momentum Desks are located on the casino floor in both Casino of the Earth and Casino of the Sky. You will need a valid photo ID to register, and you will receive your card immediately.

As a new member, you may be eligible for a $10 introductory free play bonus upon signing up. After you have your card, the high-limit table games in Casino of the Sky are located near the Sachem Lounge for convenient access. Would you like directions to the nearest desk from the hotel lobby?
